description: This file defines the 'ShoppingCartAttribute' class, which models an attribute associated with shopping cart items, including properties like option ID, value ID, attribute ID, and their corresponding names and values. It extends the 'ShopEntity' class and implements Serializable.

classes.name: ShoppingCartAttribute
classes.description: A class representing an attribute of a shopping cart item, with properties for option identifiers, attribute identifiers, and their display names.

methods.name: getOptionId
methods.description: Returns the option ID associated with this attribute.

methods.name: setOptionId
methods.description: Sets the option ID for this attribute.

methods.name: getOptionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the option.

methods.name: setOptionName
methods.description: Sets the name of the option.

methods.name: getOptionValue
methods.description: Returns the option value as a string.
